app.title: Modern Leader
settings.title: Settings
loading.error: The map could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload.
setup.aggressivenessHint: How hostile AI countries are. Their intelligence is the same at every level.
aggr.peacefulHint: Hostile traits halved; threats rarely turn into action.
aggr.realisticHint: Countries behave as they do today.
aggr.aggressiveHint: Hostile traits ×1.5; faster escalation from threats to sanctions to war.
aggr.chaosHint: Hostile traits at maximum; less predictable decisions.
setup.countryHint: Tap a country on the map or search the list.
sort.name: Name
setup.leaderHint: You replace {title} {name} as the leader of {country}. All other countries keep their real leaders.
setup.leaderHintNoName: You become the leader of {country}. All other countries keep their real leaders.
disputed.neutralHint: Own territory with a black flag, not playable.
disputed.parentHint: Part of the state they separated from.
leaderTitle.chairmanCouncil: Chairman of the Council of Ministers
leaderTitle.chairmanPresidentialCouncil: Chairman of the Presidential Leadership Council
leaderTitle.presidentCouncil: President of the Council of Ministers
game.leaveText: The game is saved automatically every turn, so you can continue it later from Load Game.
saves.overwriteText: {slot} already holds a game. It will be replaced.
saves.notASave: This file is not a Modern Leader save.
saves.unsupportedVersion: This save comes from a newer version of the game.
saves.memoryOnly: Browser storage is blocked: saves last only until the page is closed. Use Export save to keep a game.
saves.failed: The game could not be saved.
econ.title: Economy
econ.printConfirmText: You get {amount} now, but inflation will rise and the real value of money will fall.
econ.noProjects: No investments yet. Select cities in a province to invest.
invest.title: Invest
invest.notEnough: Not enough money in the treasury.
invest.allRefused: No host country agreed to this investment.
minister.inflationAlert: Inflation has reached {value}%. Prices are rising fast and people will feel it. Cut the deficit or stop printing money.
mapMode.title: Map mode
gameOver.title: Game over
gameOver.revolution: The revolution has won. After {weeks} weeks in power, {leader} has been overthrown and the rebels now rule {country}.
minister.riots: Riots have broken out in {count} provinces. Production there has fallen. Raise public support: lower taxes and inflation, spend more on services or invest in those provinces.
minister.revolution: A revolution has broken out! Rebels have taken several provinces. If they take the whole country, your government falls. Win back public support to push them out.
minister.crushed: The revolution has been crushed. The country is ours again, but the fighting has cost us production and added debt.
minister.secession: The rebels held their land for a year. It has declared independence as {state}.
interior.title: Population
interior.hint: Support rises with economic growth, public services, low inflation, low taxes and investment in a province. Below 30% a province riots.
interior.rebelsHint: Rebels advance while national support is low and retreat when it recovers. If they hold land for a year, it becomes a new country.
interior.noRiots: No riots. The people are calm.
interior.assimilateHint: Conquered provinces keep their culture: they produce less and are less loyal until assimilated.
interior.assimilateText: Assimilating {count} provinces costs {cost} and takes {weeks} weeks. Risk: support falls in those provinces while it lasts, and riots may break out.
army.title: Military
army.noPath: No way there: armies may enter only your own, allied or enemy land.
army.tooSmall: The army is too small to split.
defence.title: Armed forces
defence.serviceOn: In force: the reserves grow and recruits are plentiful.
defence.serviceOff: Not in force: no new reservists, and the reserves slowly shrink.
defence.introduceText: The reserves will grow and more people can be recruited, but public support falls by {points} points everywhere.
defence.hint: To move armies: open a province, tap + next to its armies, then open the target province and tap Move here. Entering enemy land attacks it; empty enemy provinces are taken at once.
recruit.title: Recruit soldiers
recruit.regularHint: The main army. Trained in 4 weeks.
recruit.specialHint: 2.5 times as strong, expensive and slow to train (12 weeks). Only in cities with a level 2 base or higher.
recruit.noBase: No base good enough for special forces
recruit.nothing: No one to recruit in these cities
war.declareText: Your armies may enter {country}'s land and take its provinces, and theirs may enter yours. Their allies may answer later, when diplomacy arrives.
war.alreadyAtWar: You are already at war with them.
war.invalid: You cannot declare war on them.
minister.provincesLost: The enemy has taken {places}. Send armies to win them back.
gameOver.conquered: The country has fallen. After {weeks} weeks in power, {leader} has lost the last province of {country} to the enemy.
